thesis: CROX is a high-quality, cheap, profitable name in a confirmed uptrend that has held its post-earnings gap through a market selloff, which is relative strength in a risk-off tape. The setup is a pullback entry into the SMA20 area with a tight stop below the swing low and no earnings event inside the holding window. Fundamentals are accelerating (revenue growth improving each quarter, net income +48.65% YoY) and estimate revisions are rising. The honest caveats are a hostile regime, price stalling below resistance with fading volume, and little room to the analyst target, so this is a small, scale-out-at-resistance long rather than a high-conviction one.
